about: The right Amazon listing for each part of the validation set, labelled by a checker from results-2026-11-18.json (the candidates each decision saw) and the listings' own Amazon pages, never from the tool's grade. Format: { labels: { "<bundle model>": { "<part model>": { "correct": ["<ASIN>", ...] | "none", "note": "<one line: why, with the source>" } } } }. correct lists every ASIN that is that part sold new on its own (more than one when Amazon lists it twice); "none" when no listing is it. core/test/validation.test.ts scores acceptance criterion 6 against these and skips while labels is empty.
